answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method across various datasets ... PopQA, RGBqa, PubHealth, and BalanceQA ... The model directly generates answers ... Our experiments use ... Mixtral-8x7B, Mixtral-8x22B, and Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer strings for QA prompts

answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy (Exact Match) as the performance metric ... We also use Retrieval Score (R-Score) to evaluate the necessity of retrieval and R-Token to evaluate the additional inference cost ... For scenario prediction we report F1 score.
